a.lede: The same tech start-up that discovered a PHP flaw used AI to uncover a critical software bug in one of the world's most popular computer language programs.
a.title: Security flaw found in Java, world's third-largest programming language

b.lede: Millions of sites, services, and devices are at risk of remote code execution thanks to a critical bug in the widely-used Java software. Attackers can trigger the bug by just inputting repeated text
b.title: Critical Java vulnerability puts millions of sites, services, and devices at risk of remote code execution
